stories.title: Deutsche Bank sees RBI repo rate rising to 6.25% by mid‑2027
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise its policy repo rate to 6.25% by mid‑2027, according to Deutsche Bank. The bank cites persistent inflation pressures and strong growth expectations, forecasting CPI inflation around 6% in late 2026 and 4.7% by FY28, and GDP growth above 7% for FY27 and FY28.

stories.title: Western states warn of worsening food security and famine risk in Sudan
stories.summary: The United States and 30 other Western countries issued a joint statement warning of an alarming deterioration in Sudan’s food security as the civil war continues. The World Health Organization estimates more than 33 million Sudanese need assistance, and the conflict has damaged critical infrastructure and disrupted food production. Yusuf Roble of Islamic Relief East Africa said people returning to Omdurman find homes destroyed or looted and have “very little to survive on.”

stories.title: Tata Capital Q2 FY27 net profit jumps 51% to Rs 1,660 crore
stories.summary: Tata Capital reported a 51% year‑on‑year rise in second‑quarter FY27 net profit to Rs 1,660 crore, helped by higher interest income and loan growth. Assets under management grew 26% to Rs 3.08 lakh crore and net interest income rose 23%. The firm highlighted floating‑rate loan adjustments and margin improvement as ongoing priorities.
stories.why: The earnings surge and asset expansion could boost investor sentiment and support the company’s stock price.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
stories.summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4 as a research preview on Tuesday. It generates photorealistic, interactive worlds and adds real-time audio matching the environment, including music and dialogue. Users can edit scenes on the fly—changing weather, camera angle, or adding objects—and the system maintains a consistent simulation for up to two minutes, double its predecessor's limit. Gemini acts as director coordinating visuals while Genie generates them.
stories.why: The hybrid model could accelerate AI-driven simulation for robotics and virtual testing.

stories.title: IMF Asia chief urges India to use rupee as first line of defence
stories.summary: In a video preview, Krishna Srinivasan, director of the IMF’s Asia and Pacific Department, told Indian officials that the rupee should serve as the country’s first line of defence. He noted that Asia now drives about 68 % of global growth, warned that interest rates are expected to rise, and pointed to AI‑related risks for coding jobs and the recent pull‑back of foreign investors from Indian markets.
stories.why: The IMF’s assessment can influence confidence in India’s economic data, policy credibility and macroeconomic outlook.
